roles.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Agentic Computing Foundation

bullets: Partner with HP business unit product teams to understand customer journeys, experience requirements, and priorities across commercial and consumer computing use cases.
Translate experience goals into technical product requirements, acceptance criteria, and actionable engineering stories with architecture and development teams.
Define and maintain a roadmap for foundation capabilities, aligning feature priorities, releases, and dependencies with broader HP product plans.
Work with architects to evaluate solution options and trade-offs across on-device and cloud execution, model and service integration, APIs, performance, privacy, security, and…
Help prioritize capabilities that allow multiple AI workloads to run while preserving the PC experience under memory, compute, and thermal constraints.
